Get higher education institutions

get_institutions.Rd

Institutional presence and composition from the IPEDS Institutional Characteristics survey. At county level this is counts of degree-granting institutions by control and level; at institution level it is the institution directory, one row per institution with location, sector, classification and derived flags.

Usage

get_institutions(
  geography = "county",
  geoids = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  variables = NULL,
  unitids = NULL,
  s3_bucket = "cori.data.ipeds",
  s3_path_prefix = ""
)

Arguments

geography

Grain: "county" (default) for tidy long output, or "institution" for the wide per-institution table.

geoids

Character vector of 5-digit county FIPS codes. Default NULL returns all counties. Filters by county at either level.

years

Integer vector of years. Default NULL returns all available. Coverage is 2010 to present.

variables

Character vector of county-level variable names, e.g. "inst_count". County level only – see get_ipeds_codebook().

unitids

Character vector of IPEDS unit IDs. Institution level only.

s3_bucket, s3_path_prefix

Storage location. Defaults are production.

Value

County level: geoid, year, variable, value, agg_var, survey. Institution level: the codebook's institution-level columns for this survey, plus derived flags, year and survey.

See also

get_degrees(), get_completers(), get_graduation_rates(), get_ipeds_codebook()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_institutions(geoids = "33009", years = 2022)
get_institutions(geography = "institution", geoids = "33009", years = 2022)
} # }
